slice: connected clearance classification facet in Jobs saved searches

implemented: Jobs offers All and only the six classifications defined by the existing deterministic clearance parser.
The API normalizes supported query values and rejects unsupported values; saved filters normalize and validate the same vocabulary.
Filtering matches the exact nested attributes.clearance.level value in the database before LIMIT; missing, malformed, and unrecognized stored data do not match.
The facet composes with existing direct filters and saved semantic requirements using AND.
Named saved searches preserve, restore, and clear the facet per profile; older payloads default it to empty.
Connected Chromium verified selector transport, saved-search save/reload/restore/clear, profile isolation, and no scheduling/application side effects.
The facet describes parsed job-posting text only; it does not infer user clearance or eligibility or change user preferences.
